fields.value: Expose each training checkpoint's wall time on the experiment Checkpoint record

Requested for manabot Task c5fba4 (frontier self-play at two sizes), 2026-11-07. Filed by c5fba4's operator conversation; not started. Run it on the code graph.

Problem: Etude already stores each training checkpoint's wall_ms (the training_checkpoints table, src/etude/eval/query.py, from stored.wall_ms), but the experiment API's Checkpoint record (src/etude/experiment.py:50) carries only its clocks. An experiment's eval(state) therefore cannot pair two runs' checkpoints at equal training hours while training is still running.

Outcome: Checkpoint exposes the stored wall time (wall_ms, milliseconds since epoch, as stored), populated wherever Checkpoint is built from stored training checkpoints, and None only for records that never stored it. Cut a release so manabot's control client (currently 0.2.14 overlay) can pin it.

Use: c5fba4 pairs each large-model milestone with the small model's last checkpoint at or before the same hours since each run's first checkpoint (manabot experiments/tla_frontier.py, checkpoint_hours). manabot keeps no workaround.

Acceptance: a test that a stored checkpoint's wall_ms round-trips onto Checkpoint; existing records and serialized states still load; release notes name the field. No paid compute.
